label: OPEN analyst premise: if x depends for its being on y and y does not so depend…, from being without
meaning: Derives the sufficiency of nonmutual dependence for simple priority from the dependence criterion of natural priority: if x depends on y and y not on x, then y can be without x (OPEN), x cannot be without y (OPEN), and what can be without another that cannot be without it is prior to it (OPEN reading of In V Metaph. lect. 13 n. 15).
